<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>APIVerve.API.DDGenerator</id>
    <version>1.2.0</version>
    <title>DDGenerator</title>
    <authors>APIVerve</authors>
    <license type="file">LICENSE</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://aka.ms/deprecateLicenseUrl</licenseUrl>
    <icon>favicon@128.png</icon>
    <readme>Readme.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://apiverve.com/marketplace/dndgenerator?utm_source=nuget&utm_medium=homepage</projectUrl>
    <description>D&D Generator creates random content for tabletop role-playing games including characters, NPCs, monsters, treasure, encounters, taverns, and quests.</description>
    <releaseNotes>Initial release of DDGenerator API client. Features include async/await support, automatic retries, custom headers, request logging, and cancellation token support.</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>©2026 APIVerve. All Rights Reserved</copyright>
    <tags>dnd generator dungeons and dragons rpg generator character generator npc generator api rest http client apiverve wrapper sdk</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/apiverve/dndgenerator-api" branch="refs/heads/main" commit="2878cdb345f00af84126a08bcc1be2b68ae96fec" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETFramework2.0">
        <dependency id="Newtonsoft.Json" version="13.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework=".NETFramework3.5">
        <dependency id="Newtonsoft.Json" version="13.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework=".NETFramework4.0">
        <dependency id="Newtonsoft.Json" version="13.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework=".NETFramework4.5">
        <dependency id="Newtonsoft.Json" version="13.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="System.Net.Http" version="4.3.4" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework="net6.0">
        <dependency id="Newtonsoft.Json" version="13.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="System.Net.Http" version="4.3.4" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="Newtonsoft.Json" version="13.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard2.0">
        <dependency id="Newtonsoft.Json" version="13.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="System.Net.Http" version="4.3.4" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard2.1">
        <dependency id="Newtonsoft.Json" version="13.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="System.Net.Http" version="4.3.4" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
    <contentFiles>
      <files include="any/net20/favicon.ico" buildAction="Content" />
      <files include="any/net35/favicon.ico" buildAction="Content" />
      <files include="any/net40/favicon.ico" buildAction="Content" />
      <files include="any/net45/favicon.ico" buildAction="Content" />
      <files include="any/net6.0/favicon.ico" buildAction="Content" />
      <files include="any/net8.0/favicon.ico" buildAction="Content" />
      <files include="any/netstandard2.0/favicon.ico" buildAction="Content" />
      <files include="any/netstandard2.1/favicon.ico" buildAction="Content" />
    </contentFiles>
  </metadata>
